    x_coords = sorted(point[0] for point in points)
    y_coords = sorted(point[1] for point in points)
    
    x_to_idx = {x: i for i, x in enumerate(x_coords)}
    y_to_idx = {y: i for i, y in enumerate(y_coords)}
    
    # To store the contribution of each point (x, y)
    contribution = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    
    for x, y in points:
        x_idx = x_to_idx[x]
        y_idx = y_to_idx[y]
        contribution[x_idx][y_idx] = 1
    
    # Prefix sums for the contribution grid
    prefix_sum = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(1, N + 1):
            prefix_sum[i][j] = (contribution[i-1][j-1] + 
                                prefix_sum[i-1][j] + 
                                prefix_sum[i][j-1] - 
                                prefix_sum[i-1][j-1]) % MOD
    
    total_sum = 0
    
    # Enumerate all non-empty subsets
    for size in range(1, N + 1):
        for combination in combinations(points, size):
            min_x = min(point[0] for point in combination)
            max_x = max(point[0] for point in combination)
            min_y = min(point[1] for point in combination)
            max_y = max(point[1] for point in combination)
            
            min_x_idx = x_to_idx[min_x]
            max_x_idx = x_to_idx[max_x]
            min_y_idx = y_to_idx[min_y]
            max_y_idx = y_to_idx[max_y]
            
            count = (prefix_sum[max_x_idx + 1][max_y_idx + 1] - 
                     prefix_sum[min_x_idx][max_y_idx + 1] - 
                     prefix_sum[max_x_idx + 1][min_y_idx] + 
                     prefix_sum[min_x_idx][min_y_idx]) % MOD
            
            total_sum = (total_sum + count) % MOD
    
    print(total_sum)
